caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a manual hand tool, composed of a large, four-bladed propeller-like structure connected to a wooden handle via a metal rod. The blades are predominantly blue with areas of darker and lighter shading to indicate curvature and depth. The metal rod connecting the blades to the handle is cylindrical and has a metallic gray tone. The handle itself is light brown with subtle shading to show its rounded shape and smooth surface, including a flared end. The entire object is oriented horizontally, with the blades on the left and the handle on the right, placed within a rectangular outlined frame against a plain, off-white background. The shadow from the object falls to the lower left, suggesting a light source from the upper right.
title: Chopping Knife
